title: Road Tiles
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about drawing roads out of blocks. Level 1 is straight pieces and round corners that curve the road into the grass. Level 2 is a road that bends up onto a diagonal and down onto another, made of a band block and the corner triangles beside it. Level 3 lays one road across grass, sand and water, with a crossroads, a T, a blend block where grass runs into sand and a bridge. Signs name each piece, and the pages say how many blocks a set needs and how to draw each once and flip or turn it. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and look at the blocks.

box.tagline: Draw it once, turn it, flip it.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie follows three roads seen from above: straight pieces and round corners, a road that climbs a diagonal, and a road across grass, sand and water with a crossroads and a bridge. Every piece is one block. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and look at the blocks.
features: Signs in the levels name each piece
